recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Candle Coven Carnival as a single-file browser-native Canvas game. Preserve the original top-down survival mechanics: mobile joystick/keyboard movement, a grab action for nearby collectible held items, a strike/hex action with cooldown and forward cone, chasing enemies that damage on contact, score gained by defeating enemies, persistent collectible catalog, three-hit failure, menu/index/game-over/restart states, and portrait-friendly touch controls. Transform the presentation into a Hocus Pocus witchy Halloween party: the player is a broom-riding coven host, enemies are mischievous sister shades, collectibles are spell favors, the HUD tracks Sparkle and Coven Candles, and the scene is an authored animated candlelit cauldron carnival with purple magic, green potion bubbles, autumn leaves, crescent moon, folklore houses, and campy cursed-comedy copy.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: top-down mobile arcade survival / collection combat
- objective: survive while collecting held items and defeating chasing enemies for score
- input model: virtual joystick / keyboard movement plus two actions, grab and strike
- core loop: start run, move through a bounded world, collect nearby tools, enemies spawn and chase, strike in a forward cone, score rises on enemy defeat, restart after failure
- fail/friction state: three health/candle hits; enemy contact causes damage, invulnerability flash, and eventual game over

## Protected Mechanics
- Joystick and keyboard movement semantics, player speed/friction, bounded world, camera follow, enemy spawn/chase/contact damage, pickup radius, held item behavior, strike cooldown/reach/cone damage, score-on-kill, collectible discovery persistence, three-hit loss, restart/menu/index flow.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD language, title, menus, player/enemy/relic silhouettes, procedural background, palette, particles, sound timbre labels, progression framing, grimoire copy, and mobile visual hierarchy are presentation surfaces and were transformed into a Hocus Pocus witchy Halloween party.
